jobs.title: Engenheiro (a) DevOps Pleno (Presencial em BH)
jobs.description: Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro Cloud Pleno para atuar na sustentação, evolução e otimização de ambientes em nuvem, contribuindo para a estabilidade, segurança e eficiência da infraestrutura tecnológica da organização. Você será responsável pelo atendimento de incidentes, suporte técnico, gestão de vulnerabilidades, automação de processos e implementação de melhorias contínuas, apoiando as equipes internas na construção de soluções escaláveis e seguras. Responsabilidades e atribuições Atender e apoiar usuários e equipes internas em demandas relacionadas à infraestrutura de TI e ambientes cloud. Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes, problemas e solicitações de suporte. Realizar documentação de mudanças, procedimentos operacionais e boas práticas. Administrar e sustentar ambientes em nuvem AWS. Participar de projetos de migração de sistemas e dados para ambientes cloud. Implementar e manter automações de infraestrutura utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitLab. Monitorar ambientes, identificar vulnerabilidades e apoiar ações de correção e mitigação de riscos. Garantir aderência às políticas de segurança, governança e conformidade. Apoiar iniciativas de otimização operacional e redução de custos em nuvem. Desenvolver scripts para automação de tarefas utilizando Bash e PowerShell. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência mínima de 2 anos atuando com tecnologias de Cloud Computing. Conhecimento em modelos IaaS, PaaS e SaaS. Experiência prática com AWS (Amazon Web Services). Experiência em migração de aplicações e dados para ambientes cloud. Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform, Ansible ou ferramentas equivalentes. Experiência com Git e versionamento de código. Conhecimentos intermediários em Linux, Windows Server e Redes. Experiência com monitoramento de ambientes e tratamento de incidentes. Conhecimento de práticas de segurança da informação e governança de infraestrutura. Experiência com GitLab e pipelines CI/CD. Capacidade de compreender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas. Desejáveis: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner. AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Certificação Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900). Conhecimento em linguagens como Python, Java ou Node.js. Experiência com APIs REST e serviços web. Vivência em ambientes multi-cloud. Conhecimento em FinOps e otimização de custos em nuvem. Experiência no uso de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para apoio à automação, troubleshooting, documentação e aumento de produtividade operacional. Informações adicionais Convênio Sesi e Sesc, oferecendo acesso a serviços de saúde, bem-estar e lazer; Parceria com Instituições de Ensino, com descontos exclusivos em cursos e programas educacionais; Possibilidade de crescimento na empresa e de participação em projetos estratégicos; Oportunidade de trabalhar em uma empresa do mercado em plena expansão. jobs.description: Company Description Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees. Summary Job Description The Release and Deployment Coordinator is responsible for planning, coordinating and executing software and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Releases and deployments in IT Solutions instances pipeline from development to Production. This role ensures Releases are delivered on time with quality and without unplanned services disruptions for Business Operations, while aligning with security and operational standards – in particular ITIL Change Management norms. The coordinator acts as a pivot between development, testing, automation, infrastructure, security teams and Business stakeholders. This role requires natural leadership, analytical and troubleshooting skills, and strong personal organisation to drive complex projects efficiently, along with a capacity to discuss with technical, functional and business stakeholders. Qualifications We seek a professional with at least 4-5 years of experience in release and deployment management fields , with exposure to: Platforms: Windows, Linux Database: MSSQL, PostGreSQL, Oracle ITSM Tool: ServiceNow, BMC Helix, JIRA Cloud: Microsoft Azure CI/CD Tools: Azure Pipelines, Octopus Deploy, Terraform Cloud Monitoring/Alerting: Grafana The candidate may not be fully proficient in every technology mentioned above, but must show a fair technological culture and have appetite for learning more to accelerate technical projects implementation and troubleshooting. The Release and Deployment Coordinator will work with DevOps engineers, but his/her key responsibility will be to maintain technical configurations in the deployment tool and trigger deployments in non-Production instances. jobs.title: Integrated Testing Leader
jobs.description: Job Description Essa posição é para atuar em regime presencial, em Contagem, Minas Gerais. Who will you be working with? The Integration department is responsible for providing requirements for all departments involved in the planning, development and maintenance of the PTC solutions provided by Wabtec to ensure quality, compatibility, and proper documentation. How will you make a difference? As part of the Integration department, your role will be to oversee the consolidation of system requirements, ensuring alignment between clients and development teams. You will contribute to improving and validating software architecture solutions and guarantee proper documentation of integrated tests. You will also analyze issues to identify possible causes and guide development teams in finding solutions, while supporting product deployment and maintenance. In addition, you will lead and coordinate the Integrated Testing team, ensuring clear distribution of tasks, alignment of priorities and adherence to project timelines. You will act as a technical reference, mentoring colleagues in complex analyses and fostering a culture of continuous improvement by standardizing methods and processes across the Integration Lab. This role will also support management in defining technical scope and aligning resources to customer demands, including Rumo, MRS, VLI, Vale PoC and PTC 2.0 projects. What do we want to know about you? Previous experience in railway operations. Advanced English communicating skills. Intermediate/Advanced Office Suite (Excel, Word, Powerpoint, Visio). Experience writing system requirements. Experience creating test cases and knowledge in programming languages. Knowledge of agile methodologies, SCRUM, Kanban and others. Windows operating systems. Knowledge in elaboration of work effort estimates. Knowledge elaborating technical specification documents. What will your typical day look like? Plan and supervise day-to-day activities of the testing team, monitoring workload and reallocating resources when necessary. Act as the primary interface between the Integration Laboratory and other engineering segments, ensuring alignment of technical and business expectations. Mentor junior and mid-level team members, supporting their technical and professional growth. Ensure communication flow between the team, project managers, and leadership. Coordinate reporting and progress updates, consolidating information for higher management. Oversee the use of control tools (ELM, DevOps) and encourage automation initiatives to improve efficiency and traceability. Promote standardized methods and processes, fostering consistency and continuous improvement in testing practices. Track integrated tests progress. Analyze bugs and defects and propose solutions to improve the product. Elaborate work estimates. Communicate results to leadership. Support management in defining long-term testing strategies and investment needs for infrastructure and tools. Benefícios Na Wab
